highlight.text: Here, Dürer suggested the vigorous momentum of the horsemen through the windblown clothing of the riders, the windswept clouds, and the figures trampled beneath the hooves of the approaching horses.

work.text: The first book to be both published and illustrated by the artist, it comprised a title page and 15 full-sheet woodcuts featuring text on the verso of all the sheets except the last one.

source.author: Cleveland Museum of Art
source.title: The Four Horsemen, from The Apocalypse

moment.text: The images were unique in their large scale, breadth of concept, and unity of design.

matters.text: In 1498 Dürer published a book illustrating the Revelation of John or the Apocalypse of John, the last book of the New Testament.
